raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `DeepseekV4AttnBackend.get_swa_out_cache_loc` no longer reads attention metadata on an idle forward under `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`. It returns the write locations of `RequestWindow.activate_idle`, a cached layout whose rows land in the workspace past an empty history.
- Under speculative decoding, a padded idle forward (a DP-attention rank with no requests, padded to the busy ranks' token count) skips `init_forward_metadata`. The store then read the previous forward's request-window layout, or `None` after an unpadded idle. The result was either a `TensorMatcher` failure in `fused_k_norm_rope_flashmla` (the stale `write_loc` length does not match the padded rows) or `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'core_attn_metadata'`.
- Repro: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DEP4 on 4x GB300, `--moe-a2a-backend megamoe --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`, GSM8K through sgl-eval (200 examples, 64 threads, max tokens 4096, temperature 0, no thinking). The server crashed at 197/200 when one rank ran an idle verify. With this change the run completes 200/200 at 97.50%, the same score as without encoder replay.
- The repro above ran with the Engram idle fix of #40424 applied, since main then failed first with `engram serves extend, target-verify and decode, not 4` on the same idle forward; #40424 has since merged.

No behavior change outside idle forwards with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`; idle rows were already discarded and never committed.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Fix] dsv4: Write idle SWA stores to an idle request-window layout

detail.body:

- Under speculative decoding, a padded idle forward (a DP-attention rank with no requests, padded to the busy ranks' token count) skips `init_forward_metadata`. The store then read the previous forward's request-window layout, or `None` after an unpadded idle. The result was either a `TensorMatcher` failure in `fused_k_norm_rope_flashmla` (the stale `write_loc` length does not match the padded rows) or `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'core_attn_metadata'`.

The server crashed at 197/200 when one rank ran an idle verify. With this change the run completes 200/200 at 97.50%, the same score as without encoder replay.
- The repro above ran with the Engram idle fix of #40424 applied, since main then failed first with `engram serves extend, target-verify and decode, not 4` on the same idle forward; #40424 has since merged.

No behavior change outside idle forwards with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`; idle rows were already discarded and never committed.

detail.title: [Fix] dsv4: Write idle SWA stores to an idle request-window layout

files.patch:
@@ -3948,10 +3948,15 @@ def _prefill_graph_full_topk_break(self, layer, x, q_lora, pos, forward_batch):
         )
 
     def get_swa_out_cache_loc(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> torch.Tensor:
-        """Idle always re-translates at store time: its metadata may be stale, and
-        translating the zero-padded out_cache_loc writes to the dummy slot."""
+        """Idle never trusts its metadata, which may be stale or unset: it writes
+        the request window's idle layout, or translates the zero-padded
+        out_cache_loc to the dummy slot."""
         metadata = self.forward_metadata
         if self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window is not None:
+            if forward_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
+                return self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window.activate_idle(
+                    forward_batch.out_cache_loc.shape[0]
+                )
             layout = metadata.core_attn_metadata.request_window_layout
             self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window.activate(layout)
             return layout.write_loc

@@ -222,6 +222,7 @@ def __init__(
             self._ensure_workspace(workspace_rows)
         self.layout = None
         self.prepared = None
+        self._idle_layout = None
 
     def _ensure_workspace(self, rows: int) -> None:
         if self.workspace is not None and self.workspace.size >= rows:
@@ -262,6 +263,24 @@ def activate(self, layout):
                 f"for a layout of {layout.size}"
             )
 
+    def activate_idle(self, num_rows: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Activate a layout for an idle forward, whose attention metadata is
+        stale or unset. Its rows write the workspace past an empty history, and
+        an idle forward never commits them."""
+        layout = self._idle_layout
+        if layout is None or layout.pos.numel() != num_rows:
+            zeros = torch.zeros(num_rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.tags.device)
+            layout = window_layout(
+                zeros,
+                zeros,
+                zero_row=self.zero_row,
+                capacity=self.capacity,
+                num_groups=1,
+            )
+            self._idle_layout = layout
+        self.activate(layout)
+        return layout.write_loc
+
     def initialize_dummy_history(self):
         layout = self.layout
         self.tags.fill_(-1)
